count_star.query: select count(*) from payments p where p.booking_id in(select d.booking_id from booking_details d join accommodation_snapshot s on s.id=d.accommodation_snapshot_id join accommodations a on a.id=s.accommodation_id where a.partner_id=md5('partner')::uuid)

nested_owner.query: select count(*) from payments p where p.booking_id in(select d.booking_id from booking_details d where d.accommodation_snapshot_id in(select s.id from accommodation_snapshot s where s.accommodation_id in(select a.id from accommodations a where a.partner_id=md5('partner')::uuid)))

distinct_detail_count.query: select count(distinct d.booking_id) from booking_details d join accommodation_snapshot s on s.id=d.accommodation_snapshot_id join accommodations a on a.id=s.accommodation_id where a.partner_id=md5('partner')::uuid

stats_combined.query: select count(*),count(*) filter(where b.status='pending'),count(*) filter(where b.status='cancelled'),count(*) filter(where b.status='completed'),coalesce(sum(p.received),0) from bookings b left join(select booking_id,sum(amount) received from payments where status='success' group by booking_id) p on p.booking_id=b.id where b.id in(select d.booking_id from booking_details d join accommodation_snapshot s on s.id=d.accommodation_snapshot_id join accommodations a on a.id=s.accommodation_id where a.partner_id=md5('partner')::uuid)
